entries.speaker: Old Lady
entries.en: Oh, did you come for an examination[n]with Dr. Takemi as well? She's such[n]a good doctor.

entries.speaker: Old Lady
entries.en: The pain in my foot has gone down[n]so much since I started taking her[n]medication recently.

entries.speaker: Old Lady
entries.en: Now I can even go on walks.[n]Every day has been so enjoyable.

entries.speaker: Old Lady
entries.en: Every day has been so enjoyable[n]thanks to Dr. Takemi...
